selection_rule: Eligibility: clean assignment success >= 99% at 200 bytes AND median B* <= 2 AND mean codebook-construction time <= 2x the spectral (D0) time, all measured on this validation sample only. Among eligible descriptors, ties broken by highest success, then lowest median B*, then lowest construction time. If no descriptor is eligible, the same ranking is applied to all three so a decision is still recorded, and this fallback is reported explicitly rather than silently defaulting to D0.
note: This selection is frozen before any use of the BOSSBase test_internal split, BOWS2, or COCO 2017; it is independent of, and does not retroactively change, the spectral descriptor used as the default throughout the rest of this study.
